330	// Load reads configuration from .fizeau/config.yaml (project) and
331	// ~/.config/fizeau/config.yaml (global), with env var expansion.
332	// Project config overrides global config. If no config files exist,
333	// returns defaults.
334	func Load(workDir string) (*Config, error) {
335		cfg := Defaults()
336	
337		// Try global config first, then project config (project wins)
338		var paths []string
339		if home, err := os.UserHomeDir(); err == nil {
340			paths = append(paths, GlobalConfigPath(home))
341		}
342		paths = append(paths, ProjectConfigPath(workDir))
343	
344		for _, p := range paths {
345			data, err := safefs.ReadFile(p)
346			if err != nil {
347				continue
348			}
349			expanded := expandEnvVars(string(data))
350			if err := rejectLegacyProviderReasoningKeys([]byte(expanded)); err != nil {
351				return nil, fmt.Errorf("config: parsing %s: %w", p, err)
352			}
353			if err := yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(expanded), &cfg); err != nil {
354				return nil, fmt.Errorf("config: parsing %s: %w", p, err)
355			}
356			if err := noteLegacyModelRoutes(&cfg, []byte(expanded), p); err != nil {
357				return nil, err
358			}
359		}
360	
361		// Migrate legacy flat format
362		cfg.migrateLegacy()
363	
364		// Apply env var overrides to default provider
365		cfg.applyEnvOverrides()
366	
367		if err := cfg.finalize(); err != nil {
368			return nil, err
369		}
370	
371		return &cfg, nil
372	}

376		if c.Providers != nil && len(c.Providers) > 0 {
377			return // new format takes precedence
378		}
379		if c.LegacyProvider == "" && c.LegacyBaseURL == "" {
380			return // nothing to migrate
381		}

383		provType := c.LegacyProvider
384		if provType == "" {
385			provType = inferProviderTypeFromBaseURL(c.LegacyBaseURL)
386			if provType == "" {

412	// applyEnvOverrides applies AGENT_* env vars to the default provider.
413	func (c *Config) applyEnvOverrides() {
414		if c.Providers == nil {
415			c.Providers = make(map[string]ProviderConfig)
416		}
417	
418		// Get or create default provider
419		defName := c.defaultNameForEnvOverride()
420		p := c.Providers[defName]
421		changed := false
422	
423		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_PROVIDER"); v != "" {
424			p.Type = v
425			changed = true
426		}
427		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_BASE_URL"); v != "" {
428			p.BaseURL = v
429			changed = true
430		}
431		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_API_KEY"); v != "" {
432			p.APIKey = v
433			changed = true
434		}
435		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_MODEL"); v != "" {
436			p.Model = v
437			changed = true
438		}
439	
440		// Sampling overrides forwarded by the benchmark matrix adapter.
441		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_TEMPERATURE"); v != "" {
442			if f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(v, 64); err == nil {
443				if p.Sampling == nil {
444					p.Sampling = &SamplingProfile{}
445				}
446				p.Sampling.Temperature = &f
447				changed = true
448			}
449		}
450		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_TOP_P"); v != "" {
451			if f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(v, 64); err == nil {
452				if p.Sampling == nil {
453					p.Sampling = &SamplingProfile{}
454				}
455				p.Sampling.TopP = &f
456				changed = true
457			}
458		}
459		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_TOP_K"); v != "" {
460			if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil {
461				if p.Sampling == nil {
462					p.Sampling = &SamplingProfile{}
463				}
464				p.Sampling.TopK = &n
465				changed = true
466			}
467		}
468		if v := os.Getenv("FIZEAU_MIN_P"); v != "" {
469			if f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(v, 64); err == nil {
470				if p.Sampling == nil {
471					p.Sampling = &SamplingProfile{}
472				}
473				p.Sampling.MinP = &f
474				changed = true
475			}
476		}
477	
478		if changed {
479			if p.Type == "" {
480				p.Type = inferProviderTypeFromBaseURL(p.BaseURL)
481				if p.Type == "" {
482					p.Type = "lmstudio"
483				}
484			}
485			c.Providers[defName] = p
486			if c.Default == "" {
487				c.Default = defName
488			}
489		}
490	}

805	// ResolveBackend resolves a named backend pool to a concrete provider and model.
806	//
807	// counter is the rotation index used for round-robin selection; it should be
808	// the number of prior requests against this backend pool. Callers that want
809	// stateless first-available behavior can always pass 0.
810	//
811	// overrides.Model, when set, bypasses the catalog and uses the given concrete
812	// model string. overrides.ModelRef, when set, overrides the backend's own
813	// model_ref. If neither the backend nor the overrides specify a model, the
814	// provider's configured default model is used.
815	func (c *Config) ResolveBackend(name string, counter int, overrides ProviderOverrides) (agent.Provider, ProviderConfig, *modelcatalog.ResolvedTarget, error) {
816		bc, ok := c.Backends[name]
817		if !ok {
818			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: unknown backend pool %q", name)
819		}
820		if len(bc.Providers) == 0 {
821			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: backend pool %q has no providers", name)
822		}
823	
824		idx := selectProviderIndex(bc.Strategy, counter, len(bc.Providers))
825		providerName := bc.Providers[idx]
826	
827		// Determine the effective model ref: explicit override takes priority over
828		// the backend's own model_ref.
829		effectiveOverrides := overrides
830		if effectiveOverrides.ModelRef == "" && bc.ModelRef != "" {
831			effectiveOverrides.ModelRef = bc.ModelRef
832		}
833	
834		p, pc, resolved, err := c.BuildProviderWithOverrides(providerName, effectiveOverrides)
835		if err != nil {
836			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: backend pool %q: %w", name, err)
837		}
838	
839		return p, pc, resolved, nil
